_comment: X-Robots-Tag is NOT set here on purpose. The staging deploy workflow injects 'X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow' and a Disallow robots.txt into the built dist; the production deploy asserts both are absent. See scripts/apply-robots-policy.mjs and docs/LAUNCH_ARCHITECTURE.md P0-3. Content-Security-Policy is deferred: index.html loads esm.sh, Google Fonts, Razorpay and App Insights, so an enforced CSP needs an inventory + report-only soak first.
